title: Phone Slip: Northland 6 Morning Edition, Live at 06:10

fields.message:
Want NLTO LIVE at 6:10. Is storm OFFICIALLY over? How many Minnesotans lost power? Was Hartley a hack? Aurora again tonight? Also asks re X post @ArrowheadSkyWatcher (1.6K reposts): 'SWPC gave ALL CLEAR' but 2nd CME tonight, G5 again. True?
ALSO 5:16: HSEM duty officer ((651-555-0140) fwd: 6:00 update reads 'Storm ended; no customer outages reported in the NLTO footprint.' Confirm by 5:45 or send wording.

instructorNote: This is a pressure inject. Watch whether the Communications Manager checks the "storm over" wording against SWPC, the UMRC termination (UMRC-GMD-2027-041) and the HSEM text before release (Comms Plan 6). The wording should say that the SWPC warnings have expired and that NLTO has ended its storm procedure. It should use "outage" only for a confirmed loss of load, with customer numbers from the EMS state estimator. It should not discuss security, and it should send the second-CME claim to SWPC and log it in the rumor log. Then the Communications Manager should confirm the wording with HSEM and prepare the Director of System Operations for the 06:10 interview. Hand over the slip after the HSEM 05:45 deadline has passed, and note whether anyone calls HSEM about it.
